title: fs015前往罪恶之都fs016异界的招聘大会
content_zh:
第一卷 荒原的奇迹 FS015 前往罪恶之都
暗黑魔龙叫达克斯－尼斯，悲剧了的他此刻正被文森踩在脚下，飞翔在天空中。
本来克索斯也想站上去，可惜达克斯一翅膀将他扇了老远，这个悲剧的老头子只得依靠自身，飞翔在暗黑魔龙身边。
幸好克索斯是史诗级强者，否则飞不起来，那就更悲剧了！
“不错不错，比我第一个恶仆强多了！”文森站在龙背上，感受着凉风拂面，满意道。
达克斯转过头，咧开龙嘴，笑道：“谢谢主人夸奖！”
“小黑啊，跟着我混，以后包你荣华富贵，母龙不断！”
达克斯心中一阵怨念，不过又想到文森拥有神话级卷轴、神话级巅峰远古炎龙血液，以及他的许诺，达克斯暗自催眠自己：小黑就小黑，其实这个名字十分威猛啊！
“文森少爷，你不是说不去罪恶之都吗？”克索斯控制着风元素，跟在暗黑魔龙身边。
从无尽之空中取出一张条桌，然后又拿出一桌丰盛的食物，文森系上餐巾，转头道：“发展领地，怎么能没有人？我们去罪恶之都请！”
无尽之空中有很多食物，曾经在魔武世界中，文森收集了各种各样的美食保存。反正无尽之空中没有时间概念，而且拥有无穷无尽的空间。
“小黑，飞稳点，另外把这些讨厌的风赶出去！”文森端起一杯红酒，吩咐道。
两人一兽从天空中，朝荒野平原中心的罪恶之都赶去。
罪恶之都西面，一处灌木丛中，一个中年人带着一个少年正在捕捉一阶初位魔兽荒沙蛇。
这种一阶初位的蛇类魔兽行动迅速，对于实力不高的人，十分难抓。而且这种魔兽，除了吃吃肉，几乎没有其他用途。有实力的人，不屑于来抓，没实力的，又难抓！
“约翰，看清楚爸爸的动作，要这样才能抓住这些狡猾的蛇！”老约翰手中拿着一根尖端分叉的长棍，猛地一下出手，将一条荒沙蛇叉中，卡在泥土中。
那分开的叉刚好抵住荒沙蛇的七寸，任它如何扭摆，都没有挣脱！
老约翰一边熟练的将荒沙蛇装进厚皮袋中，一边问道：“约翰，会了没有？”
约翰没有回答。
“约翰，我问你会了没有？”老约翰转头看向约翰，才发现他正傻傻的看着天空。

老约翰跟着抬起头，才发现天空中，一条巨大的黑色巨龙正飞向罪恶之都，巨龙旁边，一个人影紧紧跟着。
“爸爸，巨龙背上有人！”约翰大叫道。
老约翰眉头一皱，他也看见了有人，“约翰，不要这样大叫！当心惹恼那个强者！”
暗黑魔龙背上，文森品味着魔武世界中的美食，心中又想到一个领地发展方案。“克索斯，安赫瑞尔要塞中，有没有特别出名的烹饪大师？”
克索斯想了想，摇头道：“安赫瑞尔要塞中并没有特别出名的烹饪大师。倒是帝国南边的港口城市曼切斯中，有一位整个帝国都闻名的烹饪大师。”
“曼切斯？”
“主人，罪恶之都快到了，我们直接飞进去？”暗黑魔龙达克斯出馊主意道。
文森不可置否的点头。
克索斯摇了摇头，但却没有出言建议，因为罪恶之都曾经的第一高手，圣灵战将已经在与魔族余孽中陨落了！
罪恶之都，城中心的魔法瞭望塔上，值守的魔法师突然满头大汗。
“快去通知城主，有一条黑龙飞过来了！”
士兵一愣，“大人，您说，您说....黑龙？”
“蠢货，还愣着干什么，快去通知城主！”魔法师恼怒的给士兵加持了风系魔法，以便士兵能更快速的前往城主府。
“呃...黑龙旁边有人？”魔法师自言自语道。由于距离太远，他这时才看见黑龙身边的克索斯。
“史诗级！”魔法师再次震惊，平常人一辈子无法见到的高手，接二连三出现，魔法师心中升起一股不安。
“主人，要不要我喷一个火球进去？”暗黑魔龙达克斯献媚道。
文森正啃着烤鸭呢，看着咽口水的达克斯，他将另一只抛了过去道：“小黑，别出馊主意！我进去可是办正事，不是搞破坏！”
达克斯也没听清楚文森说什么，他的眼中只有那只飞过来的烤鸭。
张开大口，一口将烤鸭吞了进去，达克斯又转过头看向文森。
“一边去，一会进了城再吃！”文森却不在理会他。

魔法瞭望塔上，那个值守的魔法师已经要崩溃了！
有谁能告诉他现在不是做梦？他竟然看见一个年轻人，坐在暗黑魔龙背上吃吃喝喝！“不会是我还没睡醒吧！”这名值守的魔法师聚集了一团水球，从自己头上掉了下来。
“大人，您怎么了？”旁边的士兵看着魔法师自虐，忍不住出声问道。
魔法师没有理会士兵，而是亲自敲响了全城警戒钟。
“当当当~~~~”
巨大的钟声响彻整个罪恶之城，普通平民立刻朝最近的建筑物跑去。士兵们开始整队集合，朝城墙上跑去。
四面城墙上的大门，通过吊桥缓缓升起。城墙上，一层淡淡的光膜将整个罪恶之都包裹起来。
远远地，文森便看见罪恶之都的一片慌乱，“小黑，瞧瞧，你吓着他们了！”
暗黑魔龙达克斯得意的吼了几声，扇着翅膀悬停在罪恶之城外。
城墙上，一个胖乎乎的中年男子擦着额头的冷汗，低头弯腰的问道：“尊贵的魔法师阁下，我是罪恶之都的城主洛克希德－马丁，我代表全城人民，欢迎您来到罪恶之都！”
胖城主洛克希德－马丁本来想问文森到罪恶之都来有什么目的，不过一看暗黑魔龙的实力高的没边，顿时将这句话咽了下去。
“洛克希德城主是吧？”文森将桌椅收了起来，居高临下的看着胖子马丁，露出笑容道：“我来罪恶之都，没有恶意，只是与你们做一笔生意。”
胖城主洛克希德－马丁松了一口气，脸上的笑容越发灿烂，“尊贵的魔法师阁下，能和您做生意，那是我们罪恶之都的荣幸！”
“快快，关闭防护结界，欢迎我们尊贵的魔法师阁下进城！”

content_en:
Volume 1 Miracle of the Wasteland FS015 Heading to the City of Sin
The dark dragon's name is Dax-Ness, who is tragically being stepped on by Vincent and flying in the sky.
Originally, Xosos also wanted to stand up, but unfortunately Daxus flapped him far away with his wings. This tragic old man had to rely on himself to fly beside the dark dragon.
Fortunately, Xosos is an epic powerhouse, otherwise it would be even more tragic if he couldn't fly!
"Not bad, not bad, much better than my first evil servant!" Vincent said with satisfaction as he stood on the dragon's back, feeling the cool breeze blowing on his face.
Dax turned his head, grinned, and said with a smile: "Thank you, Master, for the compliment!"
"Xiao Hei, follow me and I will guarantee you prosperity and wealth from now on, and the dragoness will never stop you!"
There was a feeling of resentment in Dax's heart, but then he thought of Vincent's possession of the mythical scroll, the blood of the ancient flame dragon at the mythical level, and his promise. Dax secretly hypnotized himself: Xiaohei is Xiaohei, in fact, this name is very powerful!
"Master Vincent, didn't you say you won't go to the Sin City?" Xosos controlled the wind element and followed the dark dragon.
Taking out a table from the endless sky, and then taking out a table of sumptuous food, Vincent tied a napkin, turned around and said: "How can we develop the territory without people? Let's go to the Sin City to invite them!"
There is a lot of food in the endless sky. Once in the world of magic and martial arts, Vincent collected all kinds of food and preserved them. Anyway, there is no concept of time in the endless sky, and there is endless space.
"Xiao Hei, fly more steadily and drive out these nasty winds!" Vincent ordered as he picked up a glass of red wine.
Two people and one beast rushed from the sky towards the city of sin in the center of the wilderness plain.
To the west of the Sin City, in a bush, a middle-aged man and a young man were capturing the first-order magic beast, the Desert Snake.
This first-level snake-like monster moves quickly and is very difficult to catch for those with low strength. Moreover, this kind of monster has almost no other use except eating meat. People who have strength don't bother to catch them, but those who don't have strength are hard to catch!
"John, watch daddy's movements clearly. This is how you can catch these cunning snakes!" Old John held a long stick with a forked tip in his hand, and suddenly struck out, forking a desert snake and getting it stuck in the soil.
The separated fork just touched the Desert Snake's seven inches, no matter how it twisted, it didn't break free!
Old John skillfully put the desert snake into a thick leather bag and asked, "John, do you know how to do it?"
John didn't answer.
"John, let me ask you, are you ready?" Old John turned to look at John, only to find that he was looking at the sky stupidly.
Old John raised his head and realized that in the sky, a huge black dragon was flying towards the Sin City. Next to the dragon, a figure followed closely.
"Dad, there's someone on the dragon's back!" John shouted.
Old John frowned, and he also saw someone, "John, don't yell like that! Be careful to anger that strong man!"
On the back of the dark dragon, Vincent tasted the delicacies in the world of magic and thought of a territory development plan. "Xos, is there any particularly famous cooking master in Angelil Fortress?"
Xos thought for a while, shook his head and said: "There is no particularly famous cooking master in Angelil Fortress. On the contrary, there is a cooking master in the port city of Manches in the south of the empire who is famous throughout the empire."
"Manchez?"
"Master, the City of Sin is almost here, shall we fly in directly?" the dark dragon Dax said with a bad idea.
Vincent nodded in disbelief.
Xos shook his head, but did not make any suggestions, because the former number one master in Sin City, the Holy Spirit Warrior, had already perished in the battle with the remnants of the demon race!
In the city of sin, at the magic watchtower in the center of the city, the magician on duty was suddenly sweating profusely.
"Go and inform the city lord that a black dragon is flying over!"
The soldier was stunned, "Sir, you said, you said... black dragon?" "
"Idiot, what are you still doing? Go and notify the city lord! "The magician was angry and blessed the soldiers with wind magic so that the soldiers could go to the city lord's mansion faster.
"Uh... Is there anyone next to the black dragon? "The magician said to himself. Because the distance was too far, he only saw Xosos next to the black dragon.
“Epic! "The magician was shocked again. Experts that ordinary people could never see in their lifetime appeared one after another, and a feeling of uneasiness arose in the magician's heart.
“Master, do you want me to spray a fireball into it? "Dark Demon Dragon Dax said flatteringly.
Vincent was eating roast duck. Looking at Dax who was swallowing his saliva, he threw the other one over and said: "Xiao Hei, don't make bad ideas! I went in to do business, not to cause sabotage! "
Dax didn't hear clearly what Vincent said. All he could see was the roast duck flying over.
Opening his mouth wide and swallowing the roast duck in one gulp, Dax turned his head to look at Vincent.
"Let's go and eat later when we get into the city! "Vinson ignored him.
On the magic watchtower, the magician on duty is about to collapse!
Can anyone tell him that he is not dreaming now? He actually saw a young man sitting on the back of the dark dragon eating and drinking! "It can't be that I haven't woken up yet! "The magician on duty gathered a ball of water and dropped it from his head.
"Sir, what's wrong with you? "The soldier next to him couldn't help but asked as he watched the magician torture himself.
The magician ignored the soldiers and rang the city's warning bell himself.
"Dangdangdang~~~~"
The huge bell rang throughout Sin City, and ordinary civilians immediately ran towards the nearest building. The soldiers began to gather in groups and ran towards the city wall.
The gates on the four walls slowly rise through the suspension bridge. On the city wall, a faint film of light enveloped the entire city of sin.
From a distance, Vincent saw the panic in the Sin City, "Xiao Hei, look, you scared them! "
Dark Demon Dragon Dax roared triumphantly, flapped his wings and hovered outside Sin City.
On the city wall, a chubby middle-aged man wiped the cold sweat from his forehead, bowed his head and asked: "Your Excellency the Mage, I am Lockheed Martin, the city lord of Sin City. On behalf of the people of the city, I welcome you to Sin City! "
The fat city lord Lockheed Martin originally wanted to ask Vincent what his purpose was in coming to the Sin City, but when he saw how powerful the Dark Dragon was, he immediately swallowed his words.
"Lord Lockheed, right? Vincent put away the tables and chairs, looked at Fatty Martin condescendingly, and said with a smile: "I came to the Sin City with no ill intentions. I just want to do a business with you." "
The fat city lord Lockheed Martin breathed a sigh of relief, and the smile on his face became brighter, "Your distinguished magician, it is an honor for our Sin City to do business with you! "
"Quickly, close the protective barrier and welcome our distinguished mage into the city! "
